## Shop

Explore the museum shop and discover original prints, books, playful woodblock stamps, handmade jewellery, colourful postcards and so much more. It’s a fun little spot where you can find something unique.

Location: Ammochostou 55 – 59, Nicosia 1016  
Winter Hours: Wednesday – Saturday 10:00 am – 13:00 pm, 15:00 – 17:00 pm
